paite: Huan Jobin a dawnga, hichiin a chi a:
english: Then Job answered,

paite: Huchibang thil tampi ka zata hi: lungmuanmi chimtakhuai ngen na hi uhi.
english: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!

paite: Thu bangmahlouten tawp a nei ding uam? ahihkeileh dawng dinga nang honhihheh bang ahia?
english: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?

paite: Nou bangin kei leng ka pai thei sam hi; na kha uh ka kha muna om hileh, noute dema thute kaikhawma, ka lu hon sinkhum thei ding hi vengin.
english: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,

paite: Himahleh ka kamin nou kon hatsak dinga, ka muka muannain na lungkhamna uh kon nem ding.
english: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.

paite: Thu gen mahleng, ka dahna nepin a om keia: huan doh mahleng, hihnopin ka oma hia?
english: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?

paite: Himahleh a honchimtak saktaa: ka lawmte tengteng na hihgamta hi.
english: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made desolate all my company.

paite: Huan kip takin na honlena, huai tuh kei demna theihpihna ahi: huchiin ka gawnna kei demin a thoua, ka mai tangah a theisak hi.
english: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.

paite: A hehnain kei a honbot keka, a honsawi hi; a ha a hon gawi khuma: ka tungah ka galin a mit a tathiam hi.
english: He has torn me in his wrath, and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.

paite: A kam uh lianpiin a honkat khum ua; simmoh takin biang ah a honbeng uh: kei dou dingin a kikai khawm ua.
english: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.

paite: Pathianin pathianlimsakloute kiangah a honpe khiaa, migiloute khut ah a honpai khia hi.
english: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.

paite: Om nuamin ka om, huan a honkitam jaksaka; ahi, ka ngawngin a honmana, a honpai nen hi: a muitum dingin a hontung tou lai hi.
english: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.

paite: A thalkapmiten ka kim ka velah a hon um ua, ka sisanguite a bottata, a hawi kei; leiah ka sinkha a sung khia hi.
english: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my gall on the ground.

paite: Siatna tungah siatnain a honsesaka; galhat bangin ka tungah a tai.
english: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs on me like a giant.

paite: Ka vun tungah saiip ka khuia, leivui ah ka kingata hi.
english: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.

paite: Kahnain ka mai a hoihta keia, ka mitvunte ah sihna limliap a om hi;
english: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids.

paite: Ka khut ah hiamgamna omkei mahleh, huan ka thumna siangthou mahleh.
english: Although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

paite: Aw lei, ka sisan khuh ken, huan ka kahnain khawlmun neikei hen.
english: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.

paite: Tu mahmahin, Ngaiin, a hontheihpih van ah a oma, kei hontheihpihpa tungsangah a om hi.
english: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.

paite: Ka lawmten honnuihsan ua, himahleh ka mitin Pathian lamah khituite a sungkhia hi;
english: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,

paite: Huchia Pathian laka mihing dikna a letkip theiha, a inveng laka mihing tapa dikna, a letkip theihna dingin:Kum tawm a hongtun chiangin lah ka kik nawn louhna ding lampi ah ka pai ta ding ahi ngala.
english: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!

paite: Kum tawm a hongtun chiangin lah ka kik nawn louhna ding lampi ah ka pai ta ding ahi ngala.
english: For when a few years have come, I shall go the way of no return.
